GoalPractice Greenhealth: 30% of spend meets COHC requirements
COHC requirements · what we screen forThe five chemical classes and what each status means

A product meets Practice Greenhealth’s COHC requirements when its supplier documents it as free of all five chemical classes below, either self-declared or third-party verified.

  • Flame retardantsHalogenated and organophosphate flame retardants, often added to foam and fabrics.
  • FormaldehydeAdded formaldehyde in composite wood, adhesives and finishes.
  • PFAS / PFOSPer- and polyfluoroalkyl “forever chemicals” used for stain and water repellence.
  • PVCPolyvinyl chloride (vinyl) in upholstery, edge banding and trims.
  • AntimicrobialsAdded antimicrobial treatments in surfaces and textiles.
Meets COHC requirements free of all five Partially documented free of some, but not all five confirmed yet Does not meet no response, unknown, or no credit
